mapper.insert: INSERT INTO documents ( group_id, uploaded_user_id, file_name, file_extension, context_type, file_size, file_hash, storage_bucket, storage_object_key, status, deleted, failure_reason, root_document_id, version_number, is_current_version, uploaded_at, processed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{groupId}, #{uploadedUserId}, #{fileName}, #{fileExtension}, #{contextType}, #{fileSize}, #{fileHash}, #{storageBucket}, #{storageObjectKey}, #{status}, #{deleted}, #{failureReason}, #{rootDocumentId}, #{versionNumber}, #{isCurrentVersion}, #{uploadedAt}, #{processedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, group_id, uploaded_user_id, file_name, file_extension, context_type, file_size, file_hash, storage_bucket, storage_object_key, status, deleted, failure_reason, root_document_id, version_number, is_current_version, uploaded_at, processed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM documents where id = #{documentId} and group_id = #{groupId} and deleted = false

SELECT id, group_id, uploaded_user_id, file_name, file_extension, context_type, file_size, file_hash, storage_bucket, storage_object_key, status, deleted, failure_reason, root_document_id, version_number, is_current_version, uploaded_at, processed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM documents WHERE id = #{documentId} AND deleted = false

SELECT id, group_id, uploaded_user_id, file_name, file_extension, context_type, file_size, file_hash, storage_bucket, storage_object_key, status, deleted, failure_reason, root_document_id, version_number, is_current_version, uploaded_at, processed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM documents WHERE status = #{status} AND deleted = false
mapper.update: UPDATE documents SET is_current_version = CASE WHEN id = #{toId} THEN true ELSE false END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id IN (#{fromId}, #{toId}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM documents d WHERE d.id = #{fromId} AND d.is_current_version = true)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM documents WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND status = 'READY' AND is_current_version = true AND deleted = false

SELECT id, group_id, uploaded_user_id, file_name, file_extension, context_type, file_size, file_hash, storage_bucket, storage_object_key, status, deleted, failure_reason, root_document_id, version_number, is_current_version, uploaded_at, processed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM documents WHERE (id = #{rootDocumentId} OR root_document_id = #{rootDocumentId}) AND id != #{excludeId} AND is_current_version = true AND deleted = false

SELECT id, group_id, uploaded_user_id, file_name, file_extension, context_type, file_size, file_hash, storage_bucket, storage_object_key, status, deleted, failure_reason, root_document_id, version_number, is_current_version, uploaded_at, processed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM documents WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND uploaded_user_id = #{userId} AND is_current_version = true AND deleted = false ORDER BY updated_at DESC
